name: A Breach Starts with a Crack

scenes.summary: Nefarith has been defeated and Wuling City is being rebuilt. Zhuang Fangyi invites you to the Marker Stone Flats and tells you about a new rift forming beneath Wuling.

lines.text: Hmm? Well ... it's alright. I just arrived, too.
And you? All drenched in sweat. Did you come rushing here?
...Liar.
Nefarith left quite a mess... There's a lot on the agenda and it's a little tiring.
The AIC Factory has quickly restored our post-disaster Xiranite production. The Tianshi Pillar Array is also working properly again.
As for city repairs, Mi Fu is handling it well. And Tangtang is taking care of her Stockade. I shouldn't be asking you, but...
Words won't explain it. I should just show you myself.
Indeed, Endmin. A new rift ... has appeared under Wuling.
Hey, not again...
Technically, the fall of Nefarith should have brought peace. The lantern that symbolizes the peace of Wuling should be lit again.
But even now, the lantern remains dark.

options: Tianshi Zhuang...?
It's kinda hot today.
Yeah. Did some running to stay fit.
Saw you nodding off, too.
And I caught you napping. That makes the two of us.
Anything I can do to help?
You asked to see me. Must be something important.
Come on. I gave you a promise and we fought as a team.
A new rift...
Under Wuling...
Does that mean Wuling is still in danger?
Apologies. We were delayed.
How long did you wait?

lines.text: Definitely not. But my schedules are packed. A leisurely walk is a luxury I can't afford.
It's second nature to me. The matter is urgent so I just dragged you along without thinking.
Though I blocked Nefarith's hit, the aftershocks have compromised the Xiranite Dam. ⟦key|A new rift⟧ has appeared.
Identity verified. Highest authority level confirmed. Access granted.
Layouts of the underground area are quite complex. Stay close when we get there.

options: I bet you trained all those joggers in Wuling.
I bet you're the fastest runner in Wuling.
⟦key|Alright.⟧
Can you wait a little? I need to do something else.

scenes.summary: You take the elevator and reach the Underground Array. The appearance of the new rift has transformed this place into a chaotic and complex labyrinth. The threat posed by it exceeds your estimates. Zhuang mentions the Xiranite Nexus, a device capable of sealing the rift. However, only you can refine the device so it works as intended.

lines.text: Careful!
Thankfully we have enough Xiranite here to keep the Tianshi Pillar running at full power, which stops the rift from getting bigger.
But ... as long as the rift remains, Wuling will not be safe.
We once developed a device capable of sealing the rift. It's called the ⟦key|Xiranite Nexus⟧.
But things got in the way and development has been stalled. The device is still incomplete. We need your help.
To counter the rift, we have decided to restart R&D for our rift sealing device, the ⟦key|Xiranite Nexus⟧.
However, the project was interrupted. What we have right now is an incomplete prototype. That's where you come in.
I dragged you to the Underground Array to let you observe the rift up close, and assist you with your work.
Æther energy levels are now very low. We must retrieve the data before it climbs back up.
The observation point is up ahead. Follow me and watch your step.
We only decided to retrieve the Nexus because you are with us. We now stand a chance to complete the project quickly.
It's not surprising. After the project was stalled, the Nexus became a key component of the Xiranite Forge.

options: The situation is far more complicated than I thought.
The problem is trickier than I thought.
You brought me here because you have a solution?
What help do you need?
The Xiranite Nexus? Sounds rather familiar.

scenes.summary: A scroll portal in the underground area attracts your attention. Zhuang explains that it preserves a few residual traces from ages ago. After data transfer is complete, Æther energy levels in the underground area begin to surge. You are forced to leave.

lines.text: Yes...
Ten years ago.
The scroll preserves what the Wuling Science Station had left behind back then... Just a few traces...
Once the dust settles at this place, I'll take you there for a tour.
But ... you might be disappointed. The things inside are really old.
Transfer completed.
Not good. Æther energy levels are rising. We must go!
Data transfer in progress.

options: Is the scroll portal always here?
Where does it lead?
If that's a joke, it isn't funny.
Ten years ago?
Alright. Next stop - Xiranite Nexus.
Let's go. Time to check on the Xiranite Nexus.

lines.text: Endmin, would you mind waiting for a bit? There are a few files that need my attention.
Boss, I put the files on your desk like you said.

options: Don't worry. I can wait.
Sure. I can just sit around for a while.

lines.text: A calendar. The work agenda goes deep into the night.
A note written by Mi Fu.
"Things are hectic but if you only eat when you're free, then you're never gonna eat."
An order for a pallet of energy drinks, totaling 24 cans. The last order made was only a few days ago.
What makes you say that?
I am properly rested. Exhaustion will lead to mistakes at work.
And mistakes are something we can ill afford right now.
A tally of losses incurred by Wuling. It's better than my estimates.
Let's head to the Research Center and get the Xiranite Nexus.

options: How about taking a break?
Seems to me you haven't taken a break for a while.
Did you ever get ... some proper sleep these few days?
What's on those files?
Are the files talking about something urgent?

scenes.summary: You arrive at the Xiranite Central Laboratory, only to learn that the pressure valve has malfunctioned and the Xiranite Nexus could not be moved out of the Xiranite Forge. While everyone argues whether to forcibly take the forge apart to extract the Nexus, Zhuang asks you to help her adjust the pressure valve commands.

lines.text: Tianshi Ge, what's going on? I thought the ⟦key|Xiranite Forge⟧ would be open by now.
The forge's pressure valve is malfunctioning and can't vent at all. We can't take out the Xiranite Nexus.
Let me see... Yes. There's a problem with the pressure valve control script... Overwriting it will be difficult.
Can't we just get the engineers to take this apart?
The forge is obsolete anyway. We can't let it delay our subsequent tests.
*Sigh*. It'd be such a waste to take it apart. It might be old, but it's still useful in research and it still works.
This little old engine kept us company for quite a few years... But our need is urgent. Just get a team to dismantle it.
No rush. Perhaps ... I can try adjusting the command script.
Endmin, can you lend me a hand?

options: Sure thing. Leave it to me.
Of course. I'm actually good at that.

scenes.summary: The Xiranite Forge is open. Zhuang takes out the Xiranite Nexus and shows it to you. She then explains that low Xiranite yield and high usage risks forced them to stop the project years ago. You have a few ideas for improvement, Blight Tide data is required to validate them.

lines.text: If only we continued the project. The next iteration could have miniaturized it further for portability.
Ask away.
The Xiranite Nexus has great potential, but also problems that cannot be overcome.
It consumes vast amounts of Xiranite to work. But that's no longer an issue since we're making a lot more Xiranite.
Another problem is the way it fights the rift — it's essentially "brute-forcing".
Yes. Sudden release of Xiranite energy will react with Æther and lead to unpredictable losses.
Solving its issues within short notice will be challenging.
But with your help, the damages can be minimized and Wuling City would hardly be affected.
Of course, but the latest data has yet to be exported. This warrants a trip to the ⟦key|monitoring center⟧.
Sure. Once I'm done, I'll go find you at the monitoring center.
But I have a few things ... to entrust Tianshi Ge with.
I only saw this on a design drawing before.
*Sigh*... Years have passed since I last saw this thing.

options: Is this the Xiranite Nexus?
It's smaller than I thought.
I got some questions.
If it could stabilize rifts, why halt the project?
So it's dangerous?
I got an idea but I need surface Blight Tide data.
What are we waiting for? Let's go!
Alright. I'll head there first.

lines.text: A ten-year old vintage Bamboo Brew. It must be very precious to Zhuang Fangyi, because she has not even touched its seal.
Just delivering some files. Feel free to ignore me.
I got things to deal with. I'll be gone once the boss finish reading the documents.
